Title: Storefront Notifications — Empty State for an Account No Message Has Reached (Created on the Fly)
Preconditions: Admin API reachable. The account is created by this case: a stored account cannot stay empty on an environment that holds Sent messages with 'Track new recipients' and broad member queries, because a member matching one of those queries becomes a recipient the moment it is created (KB-CB05268E). The generated name and email must therefore contain none of the tokens the environment's tracked memberQueries use.
Test_Data: front_url={{FRONT_URL}}, back_url={{BACK_URL}}, store_id={{STORE_ID}}, password={{DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD}}, email=random-data: pushinbox-<timestamp>-<random>@qa.example (the default @qa.test domain contains a tracked token), name=random-data randomPersonName() re-drawn until clear of every tracked token
Steps:
--- ADMIN: collect the tracked member queries ---
[API] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/push-message/search  body: {"trackNewRecipients":true,"statuses":["Sent"],"take":100} -> collect every memberQuery value
--- ADMIN: create the account on the fly ---
[ACT] generate a first name plus last name with random-data randomPersonName()
[ACT] generate the email pushinbox-<timestamp>-<random>@qa.example
[ACT] re-draw the name or the email while either contains a collected memberQuery token (case-insensitive)
[API] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/members  body: {"memberType":"Contact","firstName":"<first>","lastName":"<last>","fullName":"<first> <last>","emails":["<email>"]} -> 200, capture the contact id
[API] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/security/users/create  body: {"userName":"<email>","email":"<email>","password":"{{DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD}}","memberId":"<contact id>","storeId":"{{STORE_ID}}","userType":"Customer","status":"Approved","emailConfirmed":true} -> succeeded true
[WAIT] 20 seconds, the track-new-recipients top-up window
[API] POST {{BACK_URL}}/graphql as the new account (password grant, storeId {{STORE_ID}}): { pushMessages(first: 1, withHidden: true) { totalCount } } -> totalCount 0; if it is above 0 a tracked query caught the account, report BLOCKED (not FAIL) and name the query
--- STOREFRONT ---
[NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}/sign-in
[ACT] sign in as the generated account (password {{DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD}})
[WAIT] authenticated header visible
[NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}/account/notifications
[WAIT] notifications page loads
[ACT] click the header bell 'Notifications'
[WAIT] the bell dropdown opens
Assertions:
[DOM] empty state text 'You do not have any new notifications at this time' is visible on the page
[DOM] notification list is empty — no notification items rendered

[DOM] no error messages or broken layout elements
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[API] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/pushnotifications for this user returns empty array
[NETWORK] no 4xx/5xx on page load
[CONSOLE] no JS errors on empty notifications page
Failure_Signals: Blank white page with no empty state message, spinner does not resolve, 500 error, error message shown instead of friendly empty state
Cleanup: [API] DELETE {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/security/users?names=<email> -> 200; [API] DELETE {{BACK_URL}}/api/members?ids=<contact id> -> 204
